title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New School〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Luka. What do you think Miku-P's doing? She's had her eyes closed for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... The girls are coming for practice soon, so I suppose she's psyching herself up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've seen her focus on her own before, but she seems really into it today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone, I'm gonna go practice before Ichika and the others get here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It would be a shame to throw her off, so maybe we should keep it down on our end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think that would be best.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But why is she psyching herself up so much?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I bet she's thinking she needs to work extra hard since the girls are starting second year next week.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But, she's acting as if it's the night before a big show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Look at it this way. We should follow her example! Let's practice before Ichi and the others get here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This part needs more passion and precision...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The girls are going to be second-years starting tomorrow. I need to do my best to give them an inspiring performance today.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Yes! I'm playing like I did during practice. I'm going to keep this up and push them all forward!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's like she's leading a charge...
We need to keep up.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
You all played awesomely♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I felt fired up just listening!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was thanks to Miku leading us on with her enthusiasm.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll be sure to remember the way you made me feel just now. Thank you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even still, what's gotten into you to make you so energized today?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, you are going to be second-years starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I wanted to give you guys something to get you in the right frame of mind. It seemed like a good opportunity, so I tried to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku. They start second year next week.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were wondering why you were psyching yourself up so much... Now we know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You were off by a week, Miku-P!
That's so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh... But, hey...!
One week? One day? Same difference! We're basically second-years already! Right, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, it's wonderful to be able to mentally prepare a whole week in advance!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right!
And now we're well and truly energized thanks to you, Miku. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: T-Trying so hard to make me feel better is just making me even more embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're lucky to have such nice juniors, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That wasn't the coolest thing I could've done, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm going to keep trying to be the best senior I can be.)
